fact: A Ministry of Education communiqué of 9 June 2025 on remote enrolment in the first year of basic education for 2025/2026 states that children whose parents could not enrol them on the remote enrolment platform are registered by the regional education directorates through the school-life monitoring system (منظومة متابعة الحياة المدرسية) and given unique identifiers.
